name: Potion of Healing
description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that is faintly warm to the touch. Restores 2d4+2 hit points.

name: Flask of Holy Water
description: A small flask sealed with grey wax and stamped with the Ashen Order's sigil. Thrown at a foe in combat, it bursts for 2d4 radiant damage. The restless dead burn in it.

name: Vial of Memory-Tallow
description: Distilled from the luminous spore-wax that gathers in the Under-Barrow. Drinking it steadies the mind and restores 2 mana and 1d4+1 hit points.

name: Censer of Grave-Salt
description: A clay pot packed with coarse grey salt and iron filings used by tomb-auditors to shatter calcified shells. Thrown in combat, it bursts for 2d6 force damage.

name: Alkali Clarity Draught
description: A bitter, chalk-white draught skimmed from the cooling troughs of the Iron Reliquary and tempered with clean mineral water. Restores 2d4+4 hit points.

name: Wren's Ashen Censer
description: A small iron censer Sister Wren packed with funeral ash and dried moor-thyme, still warm from her hands. Swung in combat, its smoke closes wounds for 2d6+3 and wraps you in Wren's Ward (+2 AC) for your next three turns.

name: Vaelen's Silver Chime
description: A single silver tine from a Hollow Choir carillon, tuned to a note meant to let the dead rest. Struck in combat, its pure tone shatters against a foe for 3d6 force damage.

name: Silas's Iron Standard
description: The Iron Reliquary's company standard, its scoured field newly chalked with names. Raised in combat, it heals 2d4+2 and grants Unburdened Focus (+1 AC and advantage on attack rolls) for your next two turns.
